mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing forward discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during high-rate periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting optimism about corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during strong-labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% triggers a risk-on equity reaction, compressing forward discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 106.5 triggers a supply-side optimism signal, compressing forward discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during high-INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 250 triggers a disinflation signal, reducing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1236 triggers a demand weakness signal, compressing forward discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during low-HOUST periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.5 triggers a supply-side pessimism signal, compressing forward discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during low-INDPRO periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
